Clean supported caches

Usage: mole-linux clean [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --debug                    Enable debug output
      --dry-run                  Preview every item without changing anything
      --yes                      Skip the confirmation prompt; also grants sudo consent for owner-tool actions
      --categories <CATEGORIES>  Run only these categories (comma-separated: user, browser, development, system)
      --select <SELECT>          Select rule IDs or categories (e.g. `trash` empties Trash (irreversible); `user` includes it)
      --exclude <EXCLUDE>        Skip these rule IDs or categories (comma-separated)
      --external                 Reserved for external targets; the Linux catalog has none, so this exits with an error
      --whitelist                Print the whitelist path and exit
  -h, --help                     Print help

Categories and rule IDs (for --categories, --select, --exclude):
  browser      browser-cache
  development  project-pycache, npm, pnpm, bun, corepack
  system       coredumps, pacman-cache-keep3, pacman-cache-uninstalled, orphan-packages, aur-build-dirs, journal
  user         user-essentials, trash
